summary: The HTTP adapter implements OAuth-protected MCP memory operations and passes source-level end-to-end tests.
worksToday: Serves the memory tools through MCP Streamable HTTP.
Exercises OAuth code flow, token validation, persistence, and all memory tools in source tests.
limitations: Public deployment security and scope isolation remain review-sensitive.
The end-to-end evidence is a test harness, not a clean-installed real consumer receipt.
supportedEnvironments: Windows source build; portable Rust implementation
installation: Build from source with cargo build -p elegy-memory-mcp --bin elegy-memory-mcp-http.
invocation: Configure the documented ELEGY_MCP_* variables, then run elegy-memory-mcp-http.

evidence.summary: HTTP/OAuth and memory tool source tests passed.
The HTTP binary compiled as part of the workspace suite.
